question: What is the information source for making proteins in organisms?
solution:
The correct answer is __DNA__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The DNA in the cell nucleus is the information source for making proteins.
 
• It is also the site of synthesis for ribosomes, the machine that assembles proteins.
 
• First DNA replicates itself, then DNA is transcribed into a messenger RNA (mRNA - ribonucleic acid) molecule during transcription(formation of mRNA from DNA).
 
• mRNA then gets translated(formation of protein from mRNA) to produce a protein.
 
• 
 
• A nucleus is a membrane-bound organelle that contains the cell's chromosomes.
 
• The nucleus controls and regulates the activities of the cell.
 
• It also carries the genes, structures that contain the hereditary information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5d09948885688ab8d4408e5f6d309f33ebef3a00a6785814f3fbe1ce72662af.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__Nucleolus-__

__
 
• The nucleolus is the distinct structure present in the nucleus of eukaryotic cells.
 
• The nucleolus is composed of RNA and proteins
 
• it participates in assembling the ribosomes, alteration of transfer RNA.

Mitochondria-__

__
 
• Mitochondria is cell organelles or part of a eukaryote cell. They are in the cytoplasm, not the nucleus.
 
• They make most of the cell's supply of adenosine triphosphate (ATP), a molecule that cells use as a source of energy.

Ribosomes-__

 
• The ribosome is a complex molecule made of ribosomal RNA molecules and proteins.
 
• It forms a factory for protein synthesis in cells.
